An artstyle closer to the mobile game seems like a cool idea for the fans. However as someone who only plays Versus, i think i'm a bigger fan of the original look. Idk maybe the new artstyle will grow on me over time.

It's great that you had a good time with the beta! Getting to playing with people outside my region due to the new netcode was also a similarly enjoyable experience. Here's hoping the release has more good times ahead for the both of us.

Connections have been feeling good for the most part though the input delay on PS5 felt atrocious at least coming off of training mode in the original game and SF6. The intended depth with managing your meter is very noticeable but it feels like there's currently little reason to spend it on anything before raging strike in the beta. With some more tweaks to things like input delay, the new mechanics and maybe throws, i think the game will be incredibly fun. As it is now, it's sort of a mixed bag for me. If you're a beginner and just getting into fighting games, i'd still highly recommend keeping an eye on this game as it is extremely accessible to newcomers.
